title.narrative: Trade Reform and Development in Egypt (TRADE)

description.narrative: (Egypt): The Trade Reform and Development in Egypt (TRADE) activity will increase Egypt's international trade and investments and increase exports from small and medium-sized exporting firms. This activity is anticipated to achieve the following: build the export capacity of new and expanding export-ready enterprises in selected sectors; strengthen public and private trade-support institutions (e.g., trade associations, export councils, etc.); and improve trade and investment policy along with the regulatory and institutional environment. This activity will provide a wide range of technical assistance including capacity building, procurement support, study tours, and training to Government of Egypt counterparts, quasi-government entities, and private sector stakeholders.
